current_x1_operational_negatives.observed: A combined PowerShell preflight placed native commands and exit-code checks inside expressions and failed before execution.

current_x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Never embed semicolon-separated native commands inside PowerShell parenthesized expressions or hash values.

current_x1_operational_negatives.observed: A yielded preflight wrapper preserved only its final chunk and lost earlier scalar outputs, so it earned no complete receipt credit.

current_x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Always concatenate every exec and poll chunk for long native-command probes.

current_x1_operational_negatives.observed: The first post-worktree audit repeated the native-command-in-expression PowerShell parser fault before execution.

current_x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Apply the scalar native-command guard to every history and equality receipt.

current_x1_operational_negatives.observed: A full workflow-refinement JSON rendering exceeded the useful output window and received no complete-read credit.

current_x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Compute and record the exact Git-blob and checkout SHA-256 domains separately before rerunning.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Every provenance digest must name and validate its byte domain explicitly.

current_x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Separate schema vocabulary from phase-specific route state and validate both before credit.

current_x1_operational_negatives.observed: The first staged-status diagnostic treated Git's NUL-delimited name-status stream as one record per token and falsely classified every path token as a non-added status.
